\caption{APPENDIX. How V-Read's margin over the best label-free baseline depends on the depth window it is averaged over. Per task, model and window: V-Read (the primary fit) minus the best baseline in that window, the mean over V-Read's fitted blocks inside it, the same blocks for every reader, with its paired 95\% interval (pictures resampled 1000 times, the best baseline retaken inside each resample) and the result (w win, the interval above 0; l level; b behind, the interval below 0; u untested: refusal runs without per-record readings, point estimates only). Windows: 0.3--0.6, 0.45--0.8, 0.6--0.9, 0--1 (every fitted block). The main tables use 0.45--0.8, which was set after the first depth curves were seen and is not a pre-registered choice; the whole depth (every fitted block) is the one choice that does not depend on the data. Counts by window: 0.3--0.6: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 3 win, 8 level, 2 behind; Qwen3.5-27B 3 win, 9 level, 3 behind; gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 2 win, 4 level, 3 behind (against the Jacobian lens, Patchscopes and the logit lens only); InternVL3_5-8B-HF 0 win, 5 level, 4 behind (against the Jacobian lens, Patchscopes and the logit lens only). 0.45--0.8: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 3 win, 8 level, 2 behind; Qwen3.5-27B 1 win, 6 level, 8 behind; gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 1 win, 3 level, 5 behind (against the Jacobian lens, Patchscopes and the logit lens only); InternVL3_5-8B-HF 0 win, 5 level, 4 behind (against the Jacobian lens, Patchscopes and the logit lens only). 0.6--0.9: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 1 win, 7 level, 5 behind; Qwen3.5-27B 0 win, 3 level, 12 behind; gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 0 win, 4 level, 5 behind (against the Jacobian lens, Patchscopes and the logit lens only); InternVL3_5-8B-HF 0 win, 5 level, 4 behind (against the Jacobian lens, Patchscopes and the logit lens only). 0--1 (every fitted block): Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 3 win, 6 level, 4 behind; Qwen3.5-27B 2 win, 9 level, 4 behind; gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 2 win, 4 level, 3 behind (against the Jacobian lens, Patchscopes and the logit lens only); InternVL3_5-8B-HF 0 win, 6 level, 3 behind (against the Jacobian lens, Patchscopes and the logit lens only). The best baseline of each window is chosen on the test data itself, which favours the baselines. Efficiency (depth 0.45--0.8): on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct V-Read matches or beats the best baseline in 11 of 13 tested cells (wins 3, statistically level 8) while fitting 69 times faster than the tuned lens and 23 times faster than the Jacobian lens; on Qwen3.5-27B V-Read matches or beats the best baseline in 7 of 15 tested cells (wins 1, statistically level 6) while fitting 29 times faster than the tuned lens and 26 times faster than the Jacobian lens; on gemma-4-26B-A4B-it V-Read matches or beats the best baseline in 4 of 9 tested cells (wins 1, statistically level 3) while fitting 22 times faster than the Jacobian lens, with the tuned-lens fit still running; on InternVL3_5-8B-HF V-Read matches or beats the best baseline in 5 of 9 tested cells (wins 0, statistically level 5) while fitting 19 times faster than the Jacobian lens, with the tuned-lens fit still running; Patchscopes and the logit lens need no fit, but Patchscopes costs one extra forward pass per block read per record at read time, where V-Read, the tuned lens and the Jacobian lens cost one matrix multiply per block and the logit lens nothing extra. Each cell also names, in brackets, the window's best baseline (TL, JL, PS, LL as in Table~\ref{tab:vread_main}), its wall-clock fit time over V-Read's on that model (no fit: Patchscopes and the logit lens) and its read cost: mm, one matrix multiply per block read (V-Read's cost too); fp, one extra forward pass of the model per block read, per record; 0, nothing beyond the model's own final norm and unembedding. The last row gives each model's fit times.}
\label{tab:vread_window}
